name: GitHub Issue Complexity Analyser

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub personal access token (needs Issues: read/write, Contents: read). Also used for Copilot SDK auth.

onCreateCommand: sh -c 'command -v uv >/dev/null || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; ${HOME}/.local/bin/uv sync'
postCreateCommand: sh -lc 'token=${GH_TOKEN:-$GITHUB_TOKEN}; if [ -n "$token" ]; then printf "%s" "$token" | gh auth login --with-token && (gh extension list | grep -q "github/gh-copilot" || gh extension install github/gh-copilot); else echo "GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN not set; skipping gh auth setup."; fi'
postStartCommand:
echo '✅ Dev Container Ready!

📌 Quick Start Commands:
  python app.py hello              # Simple SDK call
  python app.py hello-stream       # Streaming example
  python app.py serve              # Start web UI (http://localhost:8000)
  python app.py <github_issue_url> # Analyse GitHub issue

🔐 If GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN is set, gh auth and the Copilot CLI extension are configured automatically
🐛 Use F5 to start the debug server
'
